item.title: On 6 1/2 acres in Michigan! Nice sunroom in this fixer upper alert! 169,900
item.description: Love the sunroom and that chimney is unique! The house was built in the 1870’s. It is located on 6.5 acres in Addison, Michigan. The house features a covered front porch, large chimney, large fireplace, wainscoting, bay windows and baseboards. The house definitely needs some carpet removal! There are a couple of outbuildings, including a four car carriage house. Three bedrooms, two bathrooms and 2,318 square feet. $169,900 Contact Marcia Randall with Foundation Realty: 517-206-5237 From the Zill

item.title: Nice porch! Love the screened door! 27 acres in Mississippi. $165,000
item.description: Nice porch! Love the screened door! The house was built in 1900. It is located on 27.3 acres in Jayess, Mississippi. The house features a covered front porch, great screened door, wood walls, vintage kitchen and updated electrical. Lots of privacy with this house and property! Three bedrooms, one bathroom and 1,490 square feet. $165,000 Contact Clifton Cannon with Southern Acres Hunting and Real Estate Properties: 601-565-1070 From the Zillow listing: Welcome to the ”Get-A-Way” Step back in time

item.title: Pretty setting! Has a sauna! Fruit trees! Over three acres in Minnesota. $239,800
item.description: This is a pretty setting! There are fruit trees and a sauna. Multiple outbuildings! The house was built in 1947. It is located on 3.58 acres in New York Mills, Minnesota. The house could use some updating, but it has a lot of potential. There are multiple outbuildings on the property, including a large and heated garage and a two story barn. There are crab apple trees, lilac, asparagus, grapes and raspberries. Four bedrooms, two bathrooms and 2,340 square feet. $239,800 Contact Sara Bergstrom wi

item.title: Nice staircase! Circa 1892 in Missouri. $85,000
item.description: This is a big house with 5,000 square feet! The pictures sure aren’t the best. The house was built in 1892. It is located in St. Louis, Missouri. The house features a covered front porch, grand staircase, back staircase, wood floors, tall ceilings, crown moulding, baseboards and vintage light fixtures. 5,094 square feet. $85,000 Contact Ivy Grant with St. Louis Metro Realtors: 314-225-8566 From the Zillow listing: Prime opportunity for investors and developers in the heart of North St. Louis. item.title: Hobby vineyard on 20 acres in Nebraska! 350 grape vines. $699,000
item.description: This would be fun to own! This is a thriving hobby vineyard! There are 350 maintained grape vines and there is a drip irrigation system in place. The house was built in 1900. It is located on 20.6 acres in Bennet, Nebraska. The house features a large wrap around front porch, large back deck, wood floors, french doors and a spacious kitchen. There is a large unfinished basement. Four bedrooms, three bathrooms and 2,432 square feet. $699,000 Contact Carma Bryan with BankWise Realty: 402-770-9968 F

item.title: Pennsylvania’s most expensive old house listing! C. 1930. $9,900,000
item.description: Welcome to Pennsylvania’s most expensive old house listing! Love the pool! The house was built in 1930. It is located on 3.85 acres in Villanova, Pennsylvania. The house features English gardens, beautifully manicured lawn, tree-lined entrance, heated saltwater pool, library, media room, nanny suite and original mouldings. There is a pool and a pool house. Seven bedrooms, ten bathrooms and 11,418 square feet. $9,900,000 From the Zillow listing: This quintessential Main Line estate, sits on more

item.title: Pretty interior! Circa 1900 in New York. $249,900
item.description: This house has a pretty interior! I love that staircase and there are a lot of nice details. The house was built in 1900. It is located on .25 acre in Norwich, New York. The house features two small covered porches, wood floors, pretty staircase, crown moulding, ceiling medallions, built-ins, french doors, beautiful built-in china cabinet and wainscoting. There is a large attic for storage. The backyard is fenced and there is a detached garage. Four bedrooms, three bathrooms and 2,898 square fee

item.title: Pretty interior! Circa 1948 in North Carolina. $278,000
item.description: This house has a pretty interior! The home was built in 1948. It is located on .38 acre in Enfield, North Carolina. The house features a covered side porch, chair rails, crown moulding, paneled wainscoting, crystal chandelier, updated kitchen, coffered ceiling, built-in bookshelves, bead board and a brick fireplace. There is a fenced in backyard with a patio area and a detached storage shed. Four bedrooms, two bathrooms and 2,294 square feet. $278,000 Contact Sterling Grimes with Foote Real Esta

item.title: Pretty setting and great screened in porch! Over five acres in Virginia. $299,797
item.description: Pretty setting! I love the screened in porch! The sellers had horses and chickens at this property. The house was built in 1925. It is located in 5.37 acres in Gum Spring, Virginia. The house could use some updating and undoing of past renovations. The house features shake siding, small covered porch, screened in back porch, wood floors, brick hearth, exposed beams, crown moulding and baseboards. There are a couple of outbuildings on the property and there is a long driveway. Three bedrooms, two

item.title: Want the kitchen sink! C. 1930. Riverfront in Ohio. $347,500
item.description: I want that kitchen sink! Curious what is going on with the backyard. I am suspecting that river can be an issue. The house was built in 1930. It is located on .77 acres in Fremont, Ohio. The house features wood floors, built-in bookshelves, a lot of natural light, pretty sunroom, crown moulding, large fireplace, arched entryway, large back patio, finished basement and a back upper porch. A lot of work has been done on this house. Construction supplies will convey. Three bedrooms, three bathroom
